_help: The quest helper bar at the top right of the HUD (under the buff bar): the official bar of UI/Quest.img/Helper with the count of the registered quests. right = the right edge of the bar, top = the top edge. listTop = the top of the first quest row inside the bar, listBottomPad = the gap under the last row before the rounded bottom. rowX/rowW/rowH = one quest title block (the WZ row art is 206 wide; the height is ours). rowNameX/rowNameY and rowDetailX/rowDetailY place the two lines; rowTextPad reserves room for the X on the right; rowCloseX/rowCloseY place that X inside the row. closeDx/closeDy = the spot of the X button inside the bar, chevronDx = the spot of the chevron, chevronDownDy/chevronUpDy = the height of the chevron in its two states (the WZ puts them one pixel apart). numX1/numX2/numX3 = the spot of the count in the plate of the bar (the WZ gives one for one, two and three digits), numTop = the top of the count. The bar art (222x28), the row art (206 wide), the buttons (11x11) and the count digits (6x5) are art sizes, they stay in the code.
